canonical_statement: The human soul possesses an inherent capacity for inward contemplation and self-exploration.

attributions.surface_quote: inviting the soul to wander... in mazes of inward contemplation

canonical_statement: The initial stage of individual ontological awakening is characterized by chaos and instability.

attributions.surface_quote: beginning of... a world... is necessarily vague, tangled, chaotic

attributions.surface_quote: The voice of the sea speaks to the soul

attributions.surface_quote: the dual life--that outward existence which conforms, the inward life which questions

attributions.surface_quote: marriage... purely an accident... masquerade as the decrees of Fate

canonical_statement: Destiny or Fate determines an individual's suitability for specific social or moral responsibilities.

attributions.surface_quote: Fate had not fitted her

attributions.surface_quote: Monsieur Lebrun been removed to other spheres

attributions.surface_quote: her being was tempered to take an impress of the abiding truth

canonical_statement: Certain aesthetic experiences bypass mental imagery to directly evoke raw emotional or spiritual states within the soul.

attributions.surface_quote: saw no pictures... But the very passions themselves were aroused within her soul

attributions.surface_quote: spirits abroad to-night... twenty-eighth of August... moon is shining

attributions.surface_quote: exalted for a few hours into realms of the semi-celestials

attributions.surface_quote: thoughts were elsewhere--somewhere in advance of her body

attributions.surface_quote: yielded to his desire... unthinkingly, as we walk

attributions.surface_quote: awakens gradually out of a dream... to feel again the realities

attributions.surface_quote: freed her soul of responsibility

attributions.surface_quote: whispering voices of dead men... misty spirit forms were prowling

attributions.surface_quote: her present self-was in some way different from the other self

canonical_statement: The present moment is the only domain of existential significance.

attributions.surface_quote: The present alone was significant

canonical_statement: The past possesses no inherent instructional or deterministic value for the individual.

attributions.surface_quote: The past was nothing to her

canonical_statement: The future is an impenetrable mystery.

attributions.surface_quote: The future was a mystery

canonical_statement: The core identity or essential self is distinct from the physical life or material assets of an individual.

attributions.surface_quote: give my life... but I wouldn't give myself

attributions.surface_quote: seeking herself and finding herself in such sweet, half-darkness

attributions.surface_quote: fusion of two human beings into one... accomplished on this sphere

attributions.surface_quote: fictitious self which we assume like a garment

attributions.surface_quote: whole being seemed to be one with the sunlight

attributions.surface_quote: humanity like worms struggling blindly toward inevitable annihilation

attributions.surface_quote: gifts... which have not been acquired by one's own effort

attributions.surface_quote: the artist must possess the courageous soul

attributions.surface_quote: inner life which so seldom unfolds itself

attributions.surface_quote: music... warming and brightening the dark places of her soul

attributions.surface_quote: life, that monster made up of beauty and brutality

attributions.surface_quote: hopelessness... like something extraneous, independent of volition

attributions.surface_quote: fellowship passed around the circle like a mystic cord

attributions.surface_quote: designing Providence had led him into her path

attributions.surface_quote: Nature takes no account of moral consequences

attributions.surface_quote: drag her into the soul's slavery

attributions.surface_quote: they need not have thought that they could possess her
